summary: Read the BKZ collapse theorem and test a hybrid Frege/Nullstellensatz architecture, random pin survival and quasipolynomial budget costs.
Replay new shared-tool refusals through every in-repo caller, starting with claim_rebase on a notebook newer than its claim spec.
Prove or read the polynomial-size, constant-depth-overhead conversion from the goal's AC0[2]-Frege presentation to wrapped PK_oplus2 proofs.
Flag necessity language supported only by sufficient conditions or one construction; require a proved necessity source or route-specific wording.
Time close-built against the real notebook and closure log, reporting bytes and rows read as required for record-reading tools.
Require a review's Decisive test to name its simplest structured instance and attempted outcome before reviewer submission.
Measure browser-case scaling at two notebook sizes and remove record-dependent work to preserve timing headroom as notebooks grow.
Narrow inline substitution refusal to writing back the changed source, allowing derived files; replay prior commands before changing the guard.
Show one registry-dependency hop beside Decision-cited claims in turn guidance, measuring graph lookup cost before adding it.
Record first-reviewed draft titles and require title revision or explicit reviewer approval before append; replay historical briefs first.
Distinguish quoted matched patterns from asserted figures without exempting unsourced reviewer counts; replay catches and losses before narrowing.
Refuse sed -i substitutions on tracked tool sources as required by editing policy, after replaying legitimate and prohibited commands.
Profile and fix suite/browser timing growth instead of rerunning unchanged checks until a pass; use saved CPU evidence.
Compare new claims with latest queue-development prose and subideas sentence by sentence, calibrating resemblance catches and false positives.
Enforce quoted refusal causes before retries through a reliable harness or tool retry path; incomplete transcript text cannot certify compliance.
Close bypass-check gaps for new gate functions, meaningless evidence lines and fragment-only subprocess reads after judging replay cases.
Compare script-attributed parameter definitions with registered expressions, distinguishing contradictions from derived quantities before refusal.
Cut measured suite CPU costs enough to reserve browser headroom while meeting the suite limit; avoid unchanged timing retries.
Check approximate figures written in words in commit messages, calibrating accepted cases and false refusals on historical messages.
Resolve route blocks by remaining-route titles when next steps omit explicit route clauses; replay past steps for false refusals.
Flag titles or status lines omitting a statement's probability, domain or measure exception, with record-based replay of false flags.
Record that method barriers must use whole consumed objects and the method's exact or quotient-relative measure, with composition justified.
Prevent pipelines from masking claim build/render/validate failures and copying stale proposals; replay the existing-output refusal case.
Accept negated scope-change statements while still rejecting misleading forms such as 'not only weakened'; test and replay past gates.
Profile revision remapping on a real rewritten commit and eliminate repeated registry work, preserving mapped revision and review hashes.
Show the exact paragraph under a cited record's named heading, beyond nearest-word matches; test and replay the missed interleaved control.
Surface instance claims of construction failure or rank with their free choices, number tried and cited results, using the missed-label fixture.
Record that construction choices, named record parts and hypothesis-free steps must be checked before summaries based on one instance.
Move immutable data to separately published release assets with verified manifests and privacy gates; require grants and coordinate any history rewrite.
Compare cited displayed matrices entrywise and case counts against distinct saved records; replay the overwritten-matrix and duplicate-count misses.
Check peer-message promises for completed file/commit evidence or a queued action, calibrated on historical messages before enforcement.
Profile and fix real-load suite overruns, especially growing-notebook browser and append tests, while retaining every functional check.
Commit the saved rule requiring next-attempt family quantities to be checked and requested actions performed or filed in the same turn.
Identify Lean's new kernels and compare fresh replay time and accepted declarations before changing formalization verification.
Pilot pre-review Lean formalization and compare caught errors and cost with reviewer rounds; evaluate interactive MCP tooling with install approval.
